FAST

Nov 21 : The Confederation of African Football (CAF) announced on Saturday a return to profitability for the 2025-26 financial year with a net surplus of $31.2 million and increased total revenue of $284 million.
• The announcement was made at CAF's 48th Ordinary General Assembly in Abuja, Nigeria
• CAF’s revenue was boosted by the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco, where a record 23 commercial partners helped to generate more than $100 million for the organisation
• CAF's reserves also improved from a deficit of $16.8 million to a positive position of $14.4 million, while its cash balance position as of the year ended June 2026 stood at $118.8 million

PORTIMAO, Portugal, Nov 21 : Aprilia's Marco Bezzecchi took pole position for the Portuguese Grand Prix on Saturday, smashing the lap record at the Algarve International Circuit to snatch pole from Ducati's title-chasing Marc Marquez.
Marquez initially topped the timesheets in an overcast Q2 session but Bezzecchi stormed to pole with a lap of 1:37.201, nearly half a second quicker than the Spaniard.
"Super happy, it wasn't an easy day because the conditions were quite strange, quite tough compared to yesterday (in practice)," Bezzecchi said.
"But I felt good. I tried to take some more risk because the qualifying is too important right now and the grid for today and for tomorrow is crucial. So it was important to secure a good qualifying and the pole position is even better."

VR46 Racing's Fabio di Giannantonio will join them on the front row while Aprilia's Jorge Martin, who must ensure Marquez leaves Portugal with no more than a 36-point lead to take the title fight to the final round in Valencia, lines up seventh.
Marquez, who can win an eighth MotoGP title if he wins the sprint, leads Martin by 60 points with 74 up for grabs in the final two rounds.
Trackhouse rider Raul Fernandez was fourth fastest and is joined on the second row by Gresini Racing's Alex Marquez and KTM's Pedro Acosta.
Earlier, the Q1 session was red-flagged when Honda's Diogo Moreira suffered a highside crash, with the Brazilian violently thrown off his bike before he landed several metres away, but he escaped any major injury.
He was back up on his feet immediately to hitch a ride back to the paddock, safe in the knowledge that his fastest lap was enough to help him advance to Q2 with Ducati's Iker Lecuona, who is standing in for the injured Francesco Bagnaia.
"It was a tricky qualifying, especially after a big crash from Moreira... But it's true that on the qualifying, it was time to take a risk," Marquez said.
"Why? Because I believe that if we take a risk in the qualifying, we minimise the risk in the sprint and the main race, at least in the first (few) laps."
Organisers rescheduled the sprint to 1430 local time, 30 minutes earlier than planned, because forecast poor weather threatened to ground the medical helicopter.

Nov 21 : Confederation of African Football (CAF) president Patrice Motsepe has again endorsed Gianni Infantino for re-election as FIFA President as the Swiss confirmed a huge increase in grant payments to each member association on Saturday.  
Speaking at the organisation’s Ordinary General Assembly in Abuja, Nigeria, Motsepe said CAF was backing Infantino for another term following challenges from French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo and Kozo Tashima, honorary president of the Japan Football Association. 
"I have experienced over the last five years (as CAF president) his deep commitment. Gianni, you have our support among the 54 member associations of CAF," Motsepe said.
Infantino said he would continue to put developing football in Africa at the forefront of his agenda while FIFA president.

"You will always find in me and in FIFA a trusted partner, a trusted brother, to make sure that the dreams that we all have, the dreams that these children have in Abuja, in Cape Town, in Cairo, everywhere in Africa, can become reality," he said.
Infantino reiterated the plan to more than triple the grant given to FIFA member associations around the world, from the current $8 million over a four-year period to $25 million.
It will be effective from January 2027, three months before the FIFA presidential elections in Morocco. 
The plan to increase the grants under the new FIFA Forward 4.0 programme had been mooted in October, and is set to be ratified at a FIFA Council meeting next month.
"When I was first elected (in 2016), each federation was receiving from FIFA $250,000 a year, or $1 million every four years for football development," Infantino said.
"Now, 10 years later, you will receive $25 million to invest in football development. And we will work to make it even more than that. Because you deserve it. Because your youth deserve it.
"FIFA’s money is your money, and you invest it in infrastructure, in development and in opportunities.
"We believe in Africa, because we love Africa, because we are Africa," he said to rapturous applause.
CONMEBOL on Friday reaffirmed its unanimous support for Infantino's bid for another term, with all 10 member associations of the South American confederation backing his candidacy.

Source: Reuters

India’s cyber agency said on Friday it had reported unauthorised transactions at service providers for banking and financial services entities, and also at technology service providers supporting government-linked payments.

• Payment fraud incidents extended beyond the financial sector to vendors and partner payout platforms, cyber agency CERT-In said in an advisory on Friday

• Attackers altered business records or approval relationships and then used legitimate payment processes, it said. It did not say how much money had been improperly paid out, or by whom

Show Full Article

• The agency also said that it identified the use of AI-driven frameworks in cyberattacks across different sectors, and issued several recommendations for government organisations, non-financial payout platforms and technology service providers

• India has seen a spate of cyberattacks on banks and non-bank lenders in recent weeks, even as authorities issued warnings and the Reserve Bank of India tightened cybersecurity checks

• Earlier this month, CERT-In named the hacking group behind a wave of AI-driven attacks on financial firms and identified its tools, at least two of them linked to China

• Late last month, India’s central bank warned banks of rising cyberattacks on financial infrastructure, seeking proof of compliance with existing rules and details of their preparedness for AI-related risks

items.title: ＡＢＢロボット事業、ソフトバンクＧへの売却頓挫なら上場も　中国阻止で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anousha Sakoui　Oliver Hirt　John Revill

［ロンドン／チューリッヒ　２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Anousha Sakoui　Oliver Hirt　John Revill

［ロンドン／チューリッヒ　２０日　ロイター］ - スイスの重電大手ＡＢＢが、ソフトバンクグループ（ＳＢＧ）に売却する予定のロボット事業について、中国が売却計画を阻止したことを受け、計画が白紙になった場合に上場させることを検討していることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。

中国当局の阻止は、ＳＢＧと欧米企業との関係や、機密データが米国に移転されるリスクを懸念したためとされる。ＳＢＧはオープンＡＩの主要投資家となっている。

関係者によると、ＡＢＢとＳＢＧは計画の修正に取り組んでおり、ロボット事業の約３０％を占める中国事業を切り離し、中国企業に売却するか上場させる案が出ている。それがうまくいかなければ、ＡＢＢはロボット事業をスピンオフ（分離・独立）するか、別の相手に売却することを視野に置いている。

ただ、両社は取引の成立を最優先に考えているという。今後数週間で打開策を見出したいと考えているが、協議は２０２７年にずれ込む可能性もあると関係者は話した。

関係者の１人によると、ＳＢＧは違約金を負う可能性がある。違約金の条件は開示されていない。

ＡＢＢとＳＢＧはコメントを控えた。

中国政府は、ＡＩ開発の主導権を巡る米国との競争が激しくなる中、最先端技術が絡む買収案件を厳格に審査している。４月には米メタが、ＡＩスタートアップのＭａｎｕｓ（マナス）買収の撤回を命じられた。

ＡＢＢは中国の１３０近い都市で約３０の現地法人を運営し、従業員は１万５０００人に上る。同社のウェブサイトによると、ＡＢＢエンジニアリング（上海）にはロボット事業のグローバル本部が置かれ、重要な研究開発・生産拠点になっている。

ＳＢＧは１０月初旬にＡＢＢのロボット事業買収を発表した際、買収によって「当社のＡＩロボット事業を飛躍的に強化する」と説明していた。破談となれば打撃となる。

items.title: How AI Is Reshaping China's Industrial Policy
items.summary: Can Chinese tech companies help the country achieve technological self-reliance while keeping up in the AI arms race? On this episode, we speak with Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution’s John L. Thornton China Center and author of the High Capacity newsletter, about Beijing’s response to the global AI boom and the tensions between Chinese companies’ commercial ambitions and the government’s long-term plans. He explains how companies draw on shared expertise and supply chains to expand across industries including smartphones, robotics, EVs and semiconductors — and we also discuss Huawei’s efforts to compete with Nvidia and why technological success doesn’t necessarily translate into strong returns for stock investors in China. (Source: Bloomberg)

FAST

Nov 21 : The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) unveiled on Saturday a revamped central contract structure for 2026-27, expanding the pool of contracted players to 38 from 30, with Salman Ali Agha and Babar Azam the only players placed in the highest category.
• The PCB had said in June that only male cricketers who had played at least four tests, six one-day internationals or six Twenty20s in the previous 12 months would be eligible for central contracts.
• Under the new system, contracts are split into five specialised categories: tests and ODIs, test specialists, ODIs and T20Is, T20I specialists, and emerging players in the developmental pathway.
• The new contracts run through June 30, 2027. Players had been without central contracts since the expiry of the previous cycle in June.

items.title: Filipinas busca atraer a SpaceX: qué se sabe del interés de Elon Musk en dos islas
items.author: Carlos Cuevas
items.summary: El presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr. confirmó conversaciones con SpaceX para explorar la instalación de plataformas de lanzamiento en Filipinas, un proyecto con el que el país busca aprovechar su ubicac ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El hombre más rico del mundo, Elon Musk, estaría considerando adquirir una o dos islas en Filipinas, en medio de las conversaciones para establecer bases de lanzamiento de los cohetes de su empresa aeroespacial SpaceX ( SPCX ), según informó este viernes el presidente del país, Ferdinand Marcos Jr. “Estamos tratando de aprovechar nuestra ubicación geográfica para entrar en este negocio; ahora esperamos que Musk acepte la propuesta”, declaró en conferencia de prensa. “No pretendemos emular a la NASA ni enviar seres humanos a Marte, pero sí queremos incursionar en el sector de los lanzamientos espaciales”. Ver más: Musk se siente “tonto” por gastar US$445 millones en elecciones de mitad de mandato y se distancia de MAGA Filipinas es un país con aproximadamente 114 millones de habitantes y 7.641 islas. Aunque Marcos Jr. no precisó de qué islas se trata, explicó las ventajas geográficas que ofrecería el país para las operaciones de SpaceX, que salió a bolsa en junio de 2026 con una valoración de US$1,8 billones. “La base científica es muy clara: los lanzamientos suelen realizarse hacia el este. Dado que Filipinas se encuentra en el extremo occidental del océano Pacífico, si surgiera algún problema durante un lanzamiento, los restos caerían al mar, sin afectar a zonas pobladas”, explicó el mandatario. El embajador de Filipinas en Estados Unidos, José Manuel Romuáldez, dijo en conversación con la prensa local que Musk visita al país “muy a menudo” y “sin hacer ruido”, hecho que confirmaría el interés en las islas. Según el diplomático, el empresario estaría desarrollando proyectos en una o dos islas del archipiélago. Sin embargo, Marcos Jr. aclaró que las conversaciones con SpaceX apenas comienzan y que todavía no existen acuerdos concretos sobre los posibles emplazamientos. Musk no se ha pronunciado públicamente sobre las declaraciones. La noticia trascendió después de que SpaceX desmintiera la presencia de residuos peligrosos en las playas del norte de México producto de la explosión de un propulsor de su cohete Starship hace unos días. “Cuando recibimos informes sobre posibles restos en territorio mexicano, nos movilizamos de inmediato para enviar especialistas que ayudaran a identificarlos y dirigieran cualquier labor de limpieza necesaria”, comunicó la empresa en X. “Como se ha señalado repetidamente, las pruebas independientes realizadas sobre los materiales del interior de Starship y del propulsor Super Heavy confirman que no representan riesgos químicos, biológicos ni toxicológicos”. SpaceX realiza lanzamientos desde Starbase, su complejo de lanzamiento y fabricación ubicado en Boca Chica, en el sur de Texas, Estados Unidos, cerca de la frontera con México. En ese contexto, el presidente filipino opinó que “no es práctico limitar los lanzamientos a un solo lugar”. “Existen ventajas en realizar lanzamientos desde distintas partes del mundo”, agregó. Una semana antes de conocerse las conversaciones sobre posibles bases de lanzamiento en Filipinas, personas familiarizadas con el asunto dijeron a Bloomberg que SpaceX y Tesla ( TSLA ) están avanzando en sus negociaciones para una posible fusión. Las empresas podrían anunciar la operación tan pronto como en diciembre de 2026, aunque también han considerado principios de 2027, según las fuentes, que solicitaron mantener el anonimato debido al carácter privado de las conversaciones. Sus consejos de administración y asesores estarían ultimando los términos de la fusión y la estructura de gobierno de la entidad combinada, entre otros asuntos. De concretarse, la operación daría lugar a un conglomerado que abarcaría vehículos eléctricos, baterías de almacenamiento de energía, cohetes y satélites. La posibilidad de reunir estos activos bajo una misma estructura responde a la ambición de aprovechar la inteligencia artificial en los sectores espacial, de los vehículos autónomos y de la robótica humanoide. Ver más: Tesla abre los pedidos del Cybercab por US$29.990, pero sin pagar US$299 al mes, el auto no funcionará

items.title: Millonarios del bitcoin se interesan por estas islas del Caribe y países de América Latina para migrar
items.author: Daniel Salazar Castellanos
items.summary: Para las familias con grandes patrimonios, la elección del país de residencia, la obtención de una ciudadanía adicional y la organización de sus finanzas adquieren mayor relevancia.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El Caribe tiene el potencial de atraer a los grandes tenedores de criptomonedas con políticas que facilitan el uso de activos digitales como prueba o fuente de riqueza para obtener la residencia o la ciudadanía, según un informe de la consultora global especializada en migración por inversión Henley & Partners. Algunos de estos países han avanzado en el reconocimiento de los criptoactivos como origen de los fondos para programas de ciudadanía por inversión. Por ejemplo, Antigua y Barbuda los acepta como prueba de fondos, mientras que San Cristóbal y Nieves permite utilizarlos como fuente parcial de riqueza, según la consultora Henley & Partners. “Evidentemente se tiene que pasar sus correspondientes controles de debida diligencia y hay que demostrar el origen licito documentable”, manifestó a Bloomberg Línea Michel Soler, director general para Latinoamérica de Henley & Partners. En todo caso, “desde la perspectiva fiscal, son jurisdicciones muy amigables con sus residentes″. Según la consultora, ambas islas no cobran impuesto sobre la renta de las personas físicas, al patrimonio ni a las herencias o donaciones, entre otros gravámenes. Son jurisdicciones con un estilo de vida atractivo para los millonarios, gracias a su comunidad internacional de residentes, la cercanía y conectividad con Norteamérica y las condiciones de privacidad. Además, varios inversionistas en criptomonedas han adquirido la ciudadanía de estos países, lo que ha creado una comunidad con intereses similares, interesada en diversificar sus opciones de residencia y jurisdicción, apuntó Michel Soler. Para la consultora Henley & Partners, El Salvador y Panamá son otras jurisdicciones en Latinoamérica que llaman la atención de los millonarios. El Salvador, “notablemente”, por su programa de ciudadanía por inversión que es “único en el mundo” y que tiene como requisito una contribución no rembolsable de US$1 millón en bitcoin. Asimismo, Panamá es visto como “una jurisdicción favorable para este tipo de inversores, con un ecosistema bancario y legal amigable en la región”. Henley & Partners señala que los países que brindan “claridad, certeza y un entorno regulatorio creíble” tienen mayores posibilidades de atraer capitales de inversores en criptomonedas con movilidad internacional, según dice en el Crypto Wealth Report 2026. Para los gobiernos, el desafío consiste en crear marcos regulatorios que atraigan a nuevos inversores en activos digitales, sin dejar de lado los controles y estándares de debida diligencia. “Para los inversores que han acumulado una riqueza considerable mediante el bitcoin y otras criptomonedas, las implicaciones fiscales de vender o diversificar sus activos pueden ser significativas”, comentó a este medio Fabián Delgado, gerente de desarrollo de negocios para Colombia y LatAm del exchange Bitfinex. “La posibilidad de elegir dónde vivir, establecer un hogar para sus familias y gestionar su patrimonio a nivel internacional es también un factor determinante”. Ver más: Invertir en bitcoin en 2027: cuánto destinar de la cartera y qué factores moverán el precio, según analistas Entre los territorios del Caribe que no gravan las ganancias de capital y que suelen atraer a millonarios del sector de las criptomonedas figuran además Islas Caimán, Islas Vírgenes Británicas y Anguila, según la firma de inteligencia patrimonial New World Wealth. “En cuanto a esas islas del Caribe, ninguna de ellas cobra impuesto sobre las ganancias de capital, que es el tributo que los usuarios de criptomonedas tendrían que pagar sobre sus ganancias al venderlas”, explica a Bloomberg Línea Andrew Amoils, director de Investigación de New World Wealth. A estos destinos se suman otros territorios insulares en el océano Atlántico como Islas Turcas y Caicos, Las Bahamas y Bermudas, que también ofrece condiciones fiscales favorables para los inversionistas. Muchos de estos territorios cuentan con instituciones parlamentarias consolidadas y sistemas jurídicos basados en el derecho consuetudinario inglés (common law), lo que proporciona un entorno legal amigable para los inversores internacionales, apuntó Fabián Delgado. Otros destinos globales que no cobran impuestos sobre las ganancias de capital son Emiratos Árabes Unidos (EAU), en Medio Oriente; Mónaco, en Europa (excepto para los ciudadanos franceses, que continúan sujetos al régimen tributario de Francia por un tratado bilateral); Vanuatu y Nauru, en Oceanía, y Singapur, en Asia. “Esto refleja la naturaleza cambiante de la riqueza privada global”, escribió en el reporte Dominic Volek, director del Grupo de Clientes Privados y Miembro del Comité Ejecutivo de Henley & Partners. “El capital criptográfico no requiere ni bóveda ni sucursal bancaria, por lo que ahora los países compiten por albergar al propietario, en lugar del dinero. La actual recesión del mercado ha hecho poco por disminuir la importancia de dónde eligen establecerse los poseedores de criptoactivos”. Para las familias con grandes patrimonios, la elección del país de residencia, la obtención de una ciudadanía adicional y la organización de sus finanzas adquieren mayor relevancia. Estas decisiones inciden en la tributación y protección de sus activos, así como en el acceso a mercados y oportunidades que pueden transmitir a las siguientes generaciones, explica la consultora en su informe. Ver más: ¿Ley de rescate fiscal en Colombia le pondría impuesto al bitcoin, ether y otras cripto? así lo plantea el Gobierno El Índice de Adopción de Criptomonedas de Henley 2026, que forma parte de la misma investigación, confirma que “los inversores en activos digitales buscan cada vez más movilidad global para complementar su riqueza sin fronteras”, según indica ese documento. Este índice compara a los países que ofrecen vías de residencia y ciudadanía, evaluando la eficacia con la que adoptan y regulan las criptomonedas y la tecnología blockchain. Por la región, destaca Bahamas en el puesto 10 global y una puntuación de 39,7 sobre 60, superando a otros mercados pioneros como El Salvador, que está en la casilla 15 con una nota de 36. Bahamas se apoya en un marco legal que regula las actividades con activos digitales, la existencia del Sand Dollar -, una de las primeras monedas digitales de bancos centrales minoristas en funcionamiento -, la alta adopción de criptomonedas y un entorno fiscal favorable. Antigua y Barbuda figura en el puesto 22 (32,7) gracias a que ofrece “uno de los entornos fiscales más favorables para las criptomonedas entre los países que migran por inversión”, al no aplicar impuestos generales sobre la renta personal ni sobre las ganancias de capital. Y San Cristóbal y Nieves figura en el puesto 25 (32) puesto que “combina una sólida adopción de criptomonedas con un entorno fiscal favorable, que incluye la ausencia de impuestos generales sobre la renta personal y las ganancias de capital”. Además, dice que el país ha continuado formalizando su marco regulatorio, introduciendo legislación actualizada sobre activos virtuales y nuevas regulaciones para negocios de activos virtuales en 2026. Según el informe Crypto Wealth Report 2026, 135.694 personas poseen actualmente más de US$1 millón en criptoactivos en el mundo. Henley & Partners contabiliza 290 centimillonarios que superan los US$100 millones cada uno y 23 multimillonarios de criptomonedas que están “en la cima”. El reporte da cuenta de que bitcoin representa 92.272 de esos millonarios. El número de personas que poseen activos digitales, independientemente de la cantidad, ha alcanzado la cifra récord de 742 millones. De acuerdo con Henley & Partners, las consultas de clientes con grandes patrimonios en criptomonedas se han mantenido estables pese a la caída del mercado. En el contexto actual, los criptomillonarios priorizan temas como la diversificación de inversiones y geografías, planificación fiscal y de residencia, y seguridad familiar. Además, estos inversores son más jóvenes y tienen mayor movilidad internacional que hace una década. Ver más: ¿En qué invertir en 2027? LAS VEGAS, Nov 20 : Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc voiced frustration after neither driver reached the final top-10 phase of qualifying for Saturday night's Las Vegas Formula One Grand Prix.
Leclerc was 11th fastest and seven-times world champion Hamilton 12th after struggling for straight-line speed down the floodlit Strip on Friday, though both moved up one spot thanks to McLaren's Oscar Piastri taking a 10-place grid drop.
Hamilton said floor damage from debris early in the session had cost him.
"We lost a bunch of downforce with it, a few tenths," the Briton said. "Then we lost this deployment and I lost like six tenths just on deployment.

"When it rains, it pours. That's one of those days."
Leclerc was more critical of the team's execution after making a mistake on what he said was effectively his only meaningful lap. 
"For sure, Q3 was possible, but we didn't do a good job," said the Monegasque. 
"I made a mistake, and at the same time the execution has been very poor.
"I am very angry now, so I would rather not speak too much, but I think there were plenty of things we could have done much better."
Leclerc said the car's deficit on the long straights would make it difficult to claw back positions in the race.
"Just a very poor qualifying. We are losing a second down the straights, so there's literally nowhere we'll be able to overtake," he added.
Red Bull's Max Verstappen took pole position and will share the front row with Mercedes' George Russell. Newly crowned Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli lapped fastest but dropped to sixth due to a grid penalty.

JAKARTA: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) on Saturday (Nov 21) announced sanctions in 10 capital market violation cases, amid efforts to strengthen enforcement, bolster market integrity and protect investors.
OJK ordered the return of 23.77 billion rupiah (US$1.3 million) in illicit gains from three stock manipulation cases, involving shares of PT Grand House Mulia, PT Saraswanti Anugerah Makmur and PT Suryamas Dutamakmur.
In the Grand House Mulia case, OJK also ordered the closure of 15 securities accounts linked to the trading activity between March and July 2023.
The agency also imposed a total of 3.71 billion rupiah in administrative fines on seven listed companies for disclosure failures, material and affiliated-party transaction breaches, financial reporting violations and non-compliance with share transfer obligations.
OJK also barred multiple individuals involved in the manipulation cases from participating in Indonesia's capital markets, derivatives and carbon exchange sectors for periods ranging from three to 10 years. 
OJK previously sanctioned three listed firms as part of Indonesia's market reforms following concerns raised by global index providers over the transparency and investability of Indonesia's capital markets.

items.title: H-1B visa delays and Trump's rules force tech workers to leave US
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Uncertainty over H-1B rules and permanent residency is prompting some highly skilled Indian professionals to consider leaving the US, despite strong jobs and career prospects in its technology sector ...
items.body: By Francesca Maglione and Alicia A. Caldwell Yash Sharma decided last month that he’s had enough of the US. The 36-year-old Google software engineer from India says halfway through Donald Trump’s second term, the constant rule changes around visas for highly skilled immigrants, the unknowns they create and the slim odds of him becoming a citizen have all become too much. Sharma, who has had an H-1B visa for six years, says it’s become hard to focus at work. And while he loves his life in San Francisco and working at the epicenter of tech and AI, he feels like he’s run out of options to gain permanent residency and build a life here.  The US feels like a “golden prison,” Sharma said. He plans to move to the UK next month, even though he doesn’t have a job there, because he was offered a visa with a clear path to staying in the country for the long term. This month’s midterm elections delivered a rebuke of Trump’s immigration crackdown, helping Democrats win control of Congress and prompting the president to acknowledge that his administration may have been “too tough” in deporting people who had jobs.  But less acknowledged has been the administration’s reshaping of visa rules that for years have channeled graduates and highly skilled employees into the workforce. The newly empowered opposition won’t have an easy time reversing Trump’s rule changes, which have effectively dismantled an immigration system that helped make America a destination for the world’s best engineers and researchers. Just this week, the Labor Department proposed tighter rules for companies seeking to sponsor foreign workers for permanent residency. Some of the biggest US companies are giving up on the idea anything will change soon. International Business Machines Corp. is ending US visa sponsorships for most jobs in its largest division, leaving affected employees to transfer outside the US or plan on leaving the company by year-end. Payments company Flywire Corp. is weighing whether to put more hiring and development work overseas, while Microsoft Corp., Adobe Inc. and a handful of IT outsourcing firms have been barred from a key green-card sponsorship program as federal officials probe their practices. The Trump administration says workers and employers have abused the immigration system for years, moving it away from its origins as a way to get highly specialized talent into the country on a temporary basis into a sprawling behemoth that’s resulted in lower pay for Americans.  Research into the question of how immigrants affect wages has shown mixed results. But a recently released study by a Harvard University economist who served on Trump’s Council of Economic Advisers found skilled immigration leads to lower pay for college-educated US workers, particularly in scientific fields. Trump’s appointment this month of Stephen Miller as chief of staff gives the longtime advocate of reducing all forms of immigration greater authority, while investigations into employers’ green-card sponsorships, announced last month by Vice President JD Vance, have added to the pressure. “It’s a quiet dismantling of employment-based immigration,” said Angelo Paparelli, an immigration attorney and partner at Vialto Law. There’s a growing sense that the friction and unpredictability are the new normal for the US immigration system. That’s changing assumptions about the future of the US economy and forcing businesses to plan for a world in which they may not be able to bring top talent to work in their US headquarters.  “Economies of scale are tricky things. It’s a bit like a reputation: it can take years to build and no time to utterly destroy it,” said Scott Corley, executive director of Compete America, a coalition of major US technology and high-skilled professional employers.  Sharma says he’s felt discouraged about the chances he’d ever be able to convert his temporary visa into permanent residency given a huge backlog for Indian nationals. He hasn’t left the country in a year and a half, concerned he might not be able to get back in. That’s meant missing out on family visits, work conferences and trips with friends. Global Talent He sought another path to permanent residency and more stability by applying for an “extraordinary ability” visa, given to people with standout talent in their field, but was rejected after months of waiting. The uncertainly led Sharma to consider a life outside the US. He applied for a Global Talent visa from the UK and was approved, allowing him to move to the UK without a job and begin looking for work. He says the US election results haven’t dissuaded him from the plan. “I’ve seen various administrations, and to me it’s clear that there will be no actual change to the law,” he said. And even if things returned to how they were before, the difficulty of getting permanent residency would still weigh on him. “That normal still sucks,” he said.  Trump’s broad immigration crackdown started almost immediately after he took office. After campaigning on a pledge to end illegal immigration, the dragnet expanded to include narrowing paths for legal immigration, adding new regulations and steep fees.  By September last year, the popular H-1B visa program for high-skilled foreign workers became a focus, first with a presidential proclamation requiring a $100,000 payment for certain prospective job candidates outside the US. In August, despite a court order blocking that original payment, the administration moved to impose a separate $103,000 fee for new H-1B visa applications.Legal ChallengesMany of Trump’s policy changes are facing legal challenges, but the chaos and confusion are difficult for companies and workers to navigate. Swapnil Deshpande, who works as a senior data analyst at a major US tech firm, said that the constant changes in immigration policy have made it hard to envision a stable future in the US. The Indian national arrived in 2018 to pursue a master’s degree at Northeastern University and has been working in New York for almost six years. Every day he wakes up feeling like it could be his last in the US. He said two years ago, he had somewhat of a plan of how his next five years would go. Maybe he would start a family, buy a home and establish a life here. But in the last two years, that plan has become blurry. “Me and my wife both wanted to get a house and start a journey, but now the next question for us is like, ‘What’s going to happen next month or next day? Where will we land? What is really there for us?’” he said. “Is the uncertainty, stress, unpredictability really worth it?” Employers are also rethinking how they hire some of the most highly sought-after foreign workers.  IBM told employees this month that it would stop sponsoring foreign workers for most jobs in its consulting division, according to a document shared with managers that Bloomberg News reviewed. For Boston-based Flywire, tighter immigration rules could make it harder to hire the engineers who build its payments technology systems. The company, which handles billions of dollars in payments a month for colleges and other clients, said in a quarterly filing this month that it is considering “reallocating hiring and development activities to lower-cost jurisdictions where we already operate” to offset increases in H-1B visa costs. It warned that trouble recruiting and retaining specialists could slow its own product development, while fewer foreign students choosing American universities would mean less tuition money moving through its network. Data is beginning to show the impact of Trump’s limits. During the 2025 budget year, which included the last three full months of the Biden administration, the US issued about 260,000 fewer temporary, non-immigrant visas than the prior year, according to federal visa data analyzed by the Migration Policy Institute. International enrollment at US universities has declined, with an estimated 15% drop in new foreign students this fall, according to the Institute of International Education. Participation in Optional Practical Training, which gives international students temporary work authorization, dropped by 6% at the start of the 2026-27 academic year, marking the first decline in five years. Chris Thomas, an immigration lawyer and partner at Holland & Hart in Denver, said his corporate clients are asking about the risks they face if they choose to hire foreigners. For many of them, the thinking is “we know we’re doing oversight right, we know we are compliant with the law, but the concern is if we get charged anyway,” he said. He added that many clients fear that any perceived slip-up could prompt the government to ban them from work visa programs or launch criminal probes.  And over the long term, he said, some of his corporate clients are wondering if it’s worth the hassle of trying to navigate an increasingly complex employer-based immigration landscape. “Some are saying it’s too much, it’s time to start offshoring,” Thomas said. While legal challenges could limit the scope of Trump’s restrictions, Thomas and others said that the perception that the administration is making the US less welcoming has already broken through. “It creates this profound instability for the entire immigration ecosystem,” said Kate Angustia, supervisory policy and practice counsel at the American Immigration Lawyers Association. “We are creating a brain drain.”

items.title: 仏インフレ率、明らかに高過ぎ＝中銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パリ ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:

items.author: CNA
items.summary: Debate is growing in India about potential risks to free speech from the increasingly strict efforts of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government to remove social media content it objects to.

Meta's India offices hit by opposition protests over account removals

Debate is growing in India about potential risks to free speech from the increasingly strict efforts of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government to remove social media content it objects to.

Indian Youth Congress members storm a Meta office building during a protest against the suspension of their party leaders' accounts in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India on Nov 20, 2026, in this picture screengrab from a social media video. (Screengrab: Reuters via Indian Youth Congress)

FAST

NEW DELHI: The youth wing of India's main opposition Congress party clashed with police outside Meta offices, protesting the company's removal of some Instagram accounts of its members, according to footage released by the group on Saturday (Nov 21).
Meta declined to comment on the protests, an escalation by the influential political group in the company's biggest market by users. Debate is growing in India about potential risks to free speech from the increasingly strict efforts of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government to remove social media content it objects to.
Modi's government says it orders content taken down only if it breaches local laws, can harm public safety or national security. Congress has long accused Meta and other social media platforms of curbing dissent online by removing party accounts, favouring Modi's government.
Meta has said it restricts content in India to comply with local laws.

India tightens grip on social media with new three-hour takedown rule

MODI'S PARTY ACCUSES CONGRESS OF VANDALISM Pradeep Bhandari, a national spokesperson for Modi's ruling party, criticised Congress' actions on Saturday, saying they had "not only vandalised and destroyed Meta's office in Hyderabad" but were also "flaunting it on social media".
"This is Congress Model: Vandalise offices of Private companies," he wrote.
India's IT ministry did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
In Hyderabad on Friday, protesters carrying placards chanted slogans as they stormed into the building that houses Meta's offices, smashing plants to the ground and clashing with police, according to footage released by the Indian Youth Congress' X account.
Another video showed Congress workers spray-painting anti-Meta slogans on walls outside the building that houses its Mumbai office, clashing with security guards who tried to stop them.

Police officers detain an Indian Youth Congress member as party members protest against the suspension of their party leaders' accounts at a Meta office building in Hyderabad, Telangana, India on Nov 20, 2026, in this picture screengrab from a social media video. (Screengrab: Reuters via Indian Youth Congress)

In Gurugram near New Delhi, Congress workers chanted slogans and held banners reading "restore youth Congress accounts", official online posts showed.
The Indian Youth Congress posted warnings on X that it would "storm your offices across the country and stage protests" unless Instagram accounts of its leaders are restored.
Two such accounts were restored after Friday's protests, but thousands of accounts of journalists, creators and influencers critical of the government remain restricted, Manu Jain, who is in charge of social media for the youth group, told Reuters on Saturday.
Meta must explain how its algorithms restrict posts and must restore accounts taken down on government orders, he added.
Reporters Without Borders has said the removal of journalistic content from social media has been on the rise in India this year, and free-speech activists say a new government rule gives social media companies hardly any time to review and decide on takedown requests.
In February, Modi's government ordered social media companies to take down unlawful content within three hours of being notified about it, tightening an earlier 36-hour timeline.
Meta disclosures show that it restricted more than 5.4 million posts or accounts in India under local laws in the first half of 2026, second only to Indonesia and up from about 70,000 in the preceding six months.
"The large majority of these items included instances where we were obligated to proactively restrict content ... based on local law requirements," Meta said.

FAST

Nov 20 : Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency by market value, slid to its lowest level in two years on Friday as worries over stretched valuations in artificial intelligence stocks rattled investors and weighed on other risk assets.
It fell 5.10 per cent to $55,830 by 11:13 p.m. ET on Friday (0413 GMT on Saturday), the lowest since September 2024. It was earlier down by 3.57 per cent at $56,813.68.
Earlier on Friday it fell below $60,000 for the first time since July. 
Crypto markets have been shaken in recent sessions by weeks of concern about the profitability of massive AI infrastructure spending, rising borrowing costs, regulatory risks following Democrats' win in the US midterm elections and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's departure.
The main US stock indexes were on track for their steepest weekly decline since April 2025, when US President Donald Trump announced "Liberation Day" tariffs.

items.title: ¿Qué tan ambiciosos se consideran los latinoamericanos? Brasil y México destacan en estudio
items.author: Carlos Cuevas
items.summary: El estudio consultó a personas de 28 países sobre su propia ambición y también sobre cuáles consideran las naciones más ambiciosas. Brasil y México ocuparon el segundo y tercer lugar en la primera cla ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Brasil y México ocuparon el segundo y tercer lugar, respectivamente, entre los países cuyos habitantes se consideran más ambiciosos, según un estudio de Premier Inn, la cadena hotelera más grande del Reino Unido por número de habitaciones. Sin embargo, los resultados muestran una diferencia entre cómo los habitantes evalúan su propia ambición y cómo son percibidos desde otras naciones. Premier Inn relacionó la ambición con decisiones como hacer escapadas urbanas, tomar vacaciones de verano y buscar un trabajo que permita viajar por negocios. En ese contexto, realizó una encuesta a 5.354 personas de 28 países a través de la plataforma de investigación Prolific. El cuestionario abordó dos aspectos: cuáles consideran los participantes que son las naciones más ambiciosas del mundo y qué nivel de ambición perciben en su propio país. Ver más: Cuatro destinos de América Latina entre los 25 mejores lugares del mundo para vivir, según índice Para resolver el primer aspecto, se les pidió a los consultados votar por el que creen que es el país más ambicioso. Para ahondar en el segundo aspecto, se acudió a una Escala de Ambición de cinco ítems desarrollada en 2021 por los psicólogos Andreas Hirschi y Daniel Spurk. Los participantes calificaron su grado de ambición a partir de cinco afirmaciones relacionadas con la ambición general, la búsqueda del éxito, el establecimiento de metas claras, el deseo de lograr resultados sobresalientes y el interés por conseguir grandes cosas. Cada afirmación recibió una puntuación de cero a cinco. Así, se promediaron las puntuaciones de los participantes de cada nacionalidad para obtener un índice de ambición autopercibida por país, con valores de cero a 25. En el listado global, Brasil y México sobresalieron. El país que más se autopercibe como ambicioso es Sudáfrica, con 22,8 puntos sobre 25 en la Escala de Ambición. Allí, casi todos los encuestados afirmaron esforzarse para alcanzar el éxito y el 93% declaró que es muy importante lograr resultados sobresalientes en la vida. La segunda posición fue para Brasil, con 21 puntos. “Conocida por su ‘garra’, palabra portuguesa que significa coraje o espíritu de lucha, es evidente que los brasileños son muy apreciados por su ambición”, reseñó el informe. México completó el podio, con 20,4 puntos, y sobresalió, a juicio de sus habitantes, tanto por el esfuerzo para conseguir lo que quieren como por las metas retadoras que se imponen. El informe detalló que “casi nueve de cada diez mexicanos encuestados (88%) afirmaron esforzarse por alcanzar el éxito, y el 84% indicó que también se fija metas desafiantes”. La cuarta plaza fue para Canadá, con 20 puntos, donde un poco más de tres cuartas partes de los encuestados afirmaron que es importante para ellos lograr resultados sobresalientes en sus vidas, y la quinta fue para Portugal, la primera nación europea en el top 10. Una cosa es que los ciudadanos consideren ambiciosos a sus propios países y otra que personas de otras naciones los vean así. A Brasil y México, por ejemplo, no los ven con tanta ambición en otras partes del mundo. Por el contrario, Estados Unidos, cuyos habitantes no se atribuyen una ambición tan alta, fue considerado el país con más ambición, con el 35% de los votos. China, con el 15% de los votos, y Japón, con el 9%, completaron el podio de las naciones a las que las demás consideran como más ambiciosas. El top 15 incluye principalmente países europeos, además de India, Sudáfrica, Australia, Canadá y Brasil. A continuación, el listado completo: Ver más: Los 5 países de América Latina con mayor calidad de vida en 2026, según clasificación de Wharton

Nov 20 : SoftBank Group CEO Masayoshi Son recently approached Wall Street institutions about financing a possible trillion-dollar "buyout" of South Korean memory chip company SK Hynix, the Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The Information quoted a SoftBank spokesperson as saying Son was no longer considering such a deal. 
“SoftBank explores many opportunities, and this one is no longer under active consideration,” the report said, citing the spokesperson. 
SK Hynix said in a statement it has no knowledge of the matter described in the Information report.
It added that any foreign acquisition of the company would require prior government approval under Korean law.

items.title: South Korea's Lee says speed is vital in AI race on data centre visit
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Data centres are a major source of chip demand, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said he hoped the success of the project would draw further investment from global AI companies.
items.body:
Advertisement

East Asia

South Korea's Lee says speed is vital in AI race on data centre visit

Data centres are a major source of chip demand, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said he hoped the success of the project would draw further investment from global AI companies. 

South Korean President Lee Jae-myung attends a welcome banquet for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting at the Shenzhen International Communication Center in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, China on Nov 18, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Maxim Shemetov)

FAST

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung on Saturday (Nov 21) urged the country to move fast as it competes in the global artificial intelligence (AI) race, as he toured a data centre under construction in the southeastern city of Ulsan.
"The whole world is competing right now, and speed is vital," Lee said in a public video of his tour.
Data centres are a major source of chip demand, and he hoped the success of the project, built by South Korea's second-largest conglomerate SK Group, would draw further investment from global AI companies, Lee said.
SK Group is developing the Ulsan data centre jointly with Amazon Web Services (AWS). The estimated cost is 7 trillion won (US$5.2 billion) until 2029, South Korea's science ministry said last year. Operations are scheduled to begin in the second half of 2027.
SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won said in September that the capacity under construction was an initial 103 megawatt by 2029, with plans to expand it by nearly 900 megawatts in the future. The group is also planning further partnerships with global technology companies as the project progresses, Chey said.
On Saturday, President Lee said AI investment had mainly been concentrated around Seoul, and that the Ulsan project showed regional growth was possible.
After being told that about 900 people were working at the site, Lee said advanced facilities were short of construction workers and that ministries needed to consider how to train the workforce for building data centres and AI infrastructure.

Source: Reuters/as

items.title: ＥＣＢ主要ポストに仏独の経済学者、スペインのデコス氏が総裁へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブリュッセル／フランクフルト ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブリュッセル／フランクフルト ２０日 ロイター] - フランスは２０日、経済学者のローレンス・ブーン氏を欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の専務理事に指名した。

市場操作を担当する見通し。ブーン氏はサンタンデール銀行の幹部で、元ＯＥＣＤ（経済協力開発機構）チーフエコノミスト。

今回の発表により、国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のデコス総支配人（スペイン出身）が来年２月にラガルドＥＣＢ総裁の後任に就く見通しとなった。一方、今週初めに指名されたドイツのマルクス・ブルネルマイヤー氏（プリンストン大学教授）は、来年５月３１日に退任するＥＣＢチーフエコノミストのフィリップ・レーン氏の後を継ぐ見込みだ。

全ての指名は承認を要するが、ＥＣＢの２７人からなる政策理事会に女性が１人しか残らないことから、難航する可能性もある。ユーロ圏２１カ国の各国中銀はいずれも男性が率いており、役員会も男性が支配しているためだ。

ユーロ圏各国の中銀総裁を務めた女性は、キプロスのクリスタラ・ゲオルガジ氏ただ１人であり、ＥＣＢの役員会メンバーに就任した女性もこれまで５人に過ぎない。

欧州議会は指名に対して拒否権を行使することはできないが、女性候補者の不足に抗議して、過去に指名案の承認を保留したことがある。

とはいえ、ユーロ圏の４大国であるドイツ、フランス、イタリア、スペインがＥＣＢ役員会で事実上の常任議席を占めており、受け入れ可能な指名案を巡って数カ月にわたり交渉を重ねてきたことから、今回の指名は承認される見通しだ。

ＥＣＢウォッチャーによると、当面の間、新役員会が政策路線を変更する可能性は低い。

欧州議会は指名に対して拒否権を行使することはできないが、女性候補者の不足に抗議して、過去に指名案の承認を保留したことがある。

とはいえ、ユーロ圏の４大国であるドイツ、フランス、イタリア、スペインがＥＣＢ役員会で事実上の常任議席を占めており、受け入れ可能な指名案を巡って数カ月にわたり交渉を重ねてきたことから、今回の指名は承認される見通しだ。

ＥＣＢウォッチャーによると、当面の間、新役員会が政策路線を変更する可能性は低い。

items.title: Antonelli fastest but Verstappen on pole in Las Vegas
items.author: CNA
items.summary: LAS VEGAS, Nov 20 : Red Bull's Max Verstappen took pole position for the Las Vegas Grand Prix on Friday after newly crowned Formula One champion Kimi Antonelli lapped fastest but dropped to sixth due to a grid penalty.Mercedes' George Russell will share the front row with four-time world champion Verstappen

Antonelli fastest but Verstappen on pole in Las Vegas

Formula One F1 - Las Vegas Grand Prix - Las Vegas Strip Circuit, Las Vegas, Nevada, United States - November 20, 2026 Red Bull's Max Verstappen during qualifying REUTERS/Daniel Cole

FAST

LAS VEGAS, Nov 20 : Red Bull's Max Verstappen took pole position for the Las Vegas Grand Prix on Friday after newly crowned Formula One champion Kimi Antonelli lapped fastest but dropped to sixth due to a grid penalty.
Mercedes' George Russell will share the front row with four-time world champion Verstappen, an appetising prospect after the old foes clashed in final practice, following a chilly floodlit qualifying session in which neither Ferrari driver made it to the final top 10 phase. 
McLaren's Lando Norris will start the Saturday night race in third place with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar fourth while Mercedes' Antonelli, who became the youngest ever champion at 20 in Mexico this month, had a five-place engine penalty applied and lines up alongside Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad.
“I think we had a solid qualifying. We executed well," said Verstappen, who was helped by his teammate on the famed Strip street circuit, where slipstreaming is a key element, but still finished 0.258 seconds slower than Antonelli.

"My first lap in Q3 was pretty much as good as it can be, just with the tow effect as well around the lap.
"I think to be on the front row is very good for us." 
RUSSELL DEFIANT AFTER STEWARDS WARN VERSTAPPEN  
Verstappen, on pole for the third time this season and 51st of his career, was warned by stewards for driving erratically in final practice when he and Russell made contact. The Briton was unimpressed and revived an old beef between the two.
"There's nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who has started their lap but when you do this you are screwing this person over and he does this week in, week out, with many drivers and everybody accepts it," said Russell.
"And I'm not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they're bigger and better than everyone else. So yeah, somebody's got to stand up to that guy."
Russell and Verstappen are fighting to end the season second overall, with the Dutch driver 17 points clear and having the momentum with three races remaining.
"I wanted to be on pole but I am probably more pleased with the performance today than I was, let's say, in Mexico a couple of weeks ago when I was on the front row," said Russell in his immediate comments after getting out of the car.
"But just timing that out lap, getting the slipstream, was just huge. It was pretty crazy, very similar to what we saw in Monza."
Liam Lawson starts seventh for Racing Bulls with Alpine's Pierre Gasly eighth and teammate Franco Colapinto ninth.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc will start 10th after McLaren's Oscar Piastri, seventh fastest in the session, dropped 10 places. Ferrari teammate Lewis Hamilton will start 11th.
Russell was fastest in the first phase with Antonelli second and Leclerc third but Ferrari then suffered a nightmare in Q2.
Seven-time champion Hamilton reported a lack of grip after running off track and then struggled to find a tow to get him back up the order from 13th.
Neither of us got through?" asked Hamilton over the radio.
Verstappen was on provisional pole in the final phase with a lap of one minute 34.151 seconds, well clear of Norris in second and Russell third, after drivers jostled for position with none wanting to go first and provide a tow to those behind.
Antonelli only just made it across the line for his final flying lap but posted a best time of 1:33.893.
"We thought Kimi was either going to miss the lap or he’s going to be way too close to Lindblad," said Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff.
“He crossed the line 1.4 seconds behind, and that was basically it. So, I don’t understand how being that close you can even do this time."
(Writing by Alan Baldwin in London, editing by Peter Rutherford)

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２０日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は２０日、シーズン中のトーナメント戦であるＮＢＡカップを各地で行い、東カンファレンスＢ組のキャバリアーズはペーサーズに１２８─１１９で勝利した。

キャバリアーズはジェームズ・ハーデンが５１得点、６リバウンド、６アシストの活躍で、自身が試投した１４本のフリースローをすべて決めた。

Ｃ組のウィザーズはブルズを９８─９４で下した。アンソニー・デービスが３６得点、１１リバウンドのダブルダブルでチームをけん引した。同組のホークスはホーネッツに１１１─９７で快勝し、３連勝。ホーネッツは４連敗となった。

Ａ組のマジックはネッツに１１３─１１１で競り勝った。フランツ・ワグナーが両チーム最多の３５得点で勝利に貢献。ネッツは４連敗となった。同組のラプターズはピストンズとの接戦を１０５─１０２で制し、連敗を６でストップさせた。

西カンファレンスでは、Ｂ組のサンダーがペリカンズに１２６─１２０で競り勝った。シェイ・ギルジャス・アレクサンダーが両チーム最多の４０得点に、３リバウンド、８アシストをマーク。ペリカンズは２２得点のザイオン・ウィリアムソンら先発した３選手が２０得点超えだったが及ばなかった。

FAST

SYDNEY, Nov 21 : Cricket Australia (CA) backed Pat Cummins to remain as captain of the test and one-day international sides on Saturday and rejected any suggestion his integrity had been compromised amid the renewed furore over the 2018 ball-tampering incident.
The board met on Friday and reaffirmed its unanimous support for Cummins, whose leadership has come under scrutiny after Cameron Bancroft, one of three players sanctioned over the Sandpapergate scandal alongside David Warner and Steve Smith, published a detailed account of the incident.
CA said the meeting focused on safeguarding the integrity of the game and the welfare of those affected by the 2018 South Africa tour.
"We've expressed our support to Pat and our concern for everyone impacted by the events of the 2018 tour of South Africa," Cricket Australia Chairman David Boon said in a statement.

"We have learned from that experience and are proud of the team and the culture Pat and other leaders in the team have fostered over the past eight years and unequivocally reject any implication that Pat's integrity has been compromised."
The scandal was reignited when former batter Usman Khawaja said knowledge of the ball-tampering plot extended beyond the three players sanctioned by CA's integrity unit.
Cummins and his fellow fast bowlers Josh Hazlewood and Mitch Starc have said they knew nothing of the plan. Hazlewood on Saturday reiterated that he did not know a foreign substance was being used on the field.
CA attempted to draw a line under the scandal on Wednesday by announcing an independent forum for all the players to give their accounts of what happened in 2018 without fear of sanction.
Cummins welcomed the board's support and confirmed he would participate in the process.
"Being Australian captain carries with it an awesome responsibility. I have and never will take that lightly," Cummins said.
"I support the forum 100 per cent. I will be there. All of the players and staff I have spoken with are very keen to go and to have their say. There will be a lot of difficult conversations but that's what's needed."

KNC Info
Kyber Network is a multichain cryptocurrency liquidity center that aims to optimize and simplify the DeFi trading process by providing the user with convenient, reliable and cost-effective access to the DeFi market.
The main product of the project, KyberSwap, is a decentralized exchange and liquidity aggregator operating on the principle of providing the best exchange conditions in various blockchain networks. To help users make decisions and automate processes, KyberSwap offers tools and functionality. The platform currently operates on 11 blockchain networks, including Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche.
KyberSwap is an aggregator that provides access to over 20,000 tokens and $34 billion in TVL through over 60 decentralized exchanges across 11 networks. Through dynamic routing among various liquidity pools, the platform guarantees the best exchange rates using advanced smart contracts and arbitrage capabilities, while not charging additional aggregation fees. In addition, KyberSwap offers a Discover tool to identify potentially popular DeFi tokens based on an analysis of network activity and trading trends.
For liquidity providers, KyberSwap offers the Dynamic Market Maker (DMM) protocol, an enhanced version of the standard AMM. Based on market volatility, fees are dynamically adjusted to reflect current risks. Additionally, the protocol includes a “programmable price curve” — Amplification (AMP) function, which allows you to effectively simulate high liquidity even with small pool volumes, while providers can configure AMP parameters in accordance with the characteristics of the selected pair of tokens.
The token of the Kyber Network project, Kyber Network Crystal (KNC), is based on the ERC-20 standard and plays the role of a motivational tool in the Kyber ecosystem. KNC holders have the opportunity to delegate their tokens to KyberDAO to participate in voting and receive rewards.

Christmas, winter scene, or fully abstract: any style, any medium. No Santasâ€¦

XTZ Info
Tezos is a distinctive blockchain platform architected to facilitate and govern decentralized applications (dApps) and smart contracts. Its foundation is built on a decentralized governance system that enables blockchain modifications through a community-led decision-making process.
Operating on a unique iteration of Proof of Stake (PoS) mechanism known as Liquid Proof of Stake (LPoS), Tezos allows participants owning more than 6,000 Tez (XTZ) to become delegates, or “bakers”. These bakers are responsible for creating, signing, and publishing new blocks on the Tezos blockchain, and endorsing blocks produced by other bakers. Furthermore, the network utilizes the Michelson programming language for the creation of smart contracts, which engage with the network’s cryptocurrency, Tez, for transaction execution and gas payment.
The native token of Tezos, XTZ, or Tez, plays a multifaceted role within the ecosystem. It serves as a reward for participation in the creation and endorsement of new blocks, either directly or through delegation. It functions as a voting mechanism within the decentralized governance system. Additionally, it is a means of value transfer and is used to pay for gas, the unit of computational effort in Tezos, necessary for executing transactions and interacting with smart contracts.

items.title: Nations at UN talks on AI killer robots agree to more talks but no firm commitment to rein them in
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Opposition from big arms-producing nations like the US and Russia had resulted in a watered-down agreement that left open the question of whether future measures would be legally binding.
items.body:
Advertisement

Nations at UN talks on AI killer robots agree to more talks but no firm commitment to rein them in

Opposition from big arms-producing nations like the US and Russia had resulted in a watered-down agreement that left open the question of whether future measures would be legally binding.

Delegates attend the United Nations (UN) Review Conference of the High Contracting Parties to the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW), where discussions focus on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (LAWS), often referred to as “killer robots”, in Geneva on Nov 16, 2026. (File photo: AFP/Fabrice Coffrini)

FAST

GENEVA: Efforts to set firm rules on AI-powered killer robots and drones ran aground on Saturday (Nov 21) as UN-backed talks in Geneva produced a softened agreement to extend discussions for two more years.
Scores of countries ended the week-long UN conference on weapons by agreeing to “elaborate” a possible accord on such lethal autonomous weapons systems by 2028. But they did not commit to binding rules sought by UN Secretary-General António Guterres, many countries, and activists.
The outcome underscored the difficulty of achieving concrete results in diplomacy amid global conflicts and major military powers jockeying for dominance.
Izumi Nakamitsu, the UN high representative for disarmament affairs, hailed a “significant achievement” but acknowledged a “glass half full or half empty” scenario, citing Guterres’ hopes for a legally binding deal this year.

Activists accused military powers like Russia and the United States of blocking stronger language.

A mock "killer robot" is pictured as part of the Campaign to Stop "Killer Robots", which calls for the ban of lethal robot weapons that would be able to select and attack targets without any human intervention. (Photo: AFP/Carl Court)

Stop Killer Robots lamented a “watered-down mandate”, and Beatrice Fihn, founder of international law advocacy group Lex International, said the decision amounts to “pushing the can down the road for two more years".
They noted most countries supported work toward a new treaty, and Max Tegmark, a machine learning specialist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and founder of the Future of Life Institute, said: “States have agreed it is sufficient to just talk about the issue, for the 14th year, while these weapons enable atrocities.”
Before the meeting, seven countries proposed launching negotiations on a rulebook that could prevent or limit the ability of machines to kill without human control or accountability. That effort fell short.
“Technology is moving faster than diplomacy,” said Ambassador Frederico Meyer of Brazil, which joined Austria, Belgium, Ireland, Mexico, New Zealand and Panama in proposing such negotiations. “Diplomats are very slow.”
After years of talks on the issue, advocacy groups bemoaned obstructionism largely by Russia, which, like other top AI weapons-developing countries such as the United States, wants a freer hand to develop such high-tech weapons.
Guterres, who leaves office at the end of the year, set a 2026 deadline for launching negotiations toward an agreement on autonomous weapons systems.
Pope Leo XIV and many advocacy and humanitarian groups have framed the issue as an existential debate, urging quick action to rein in AI weapons before they become too commonplace to regulate easily.
Activists say armed drones that can independently strike targets have already been deployed in some select instances in conflict zones, but widespread rollout hasn’t happened.
Talks this week centred on the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons, ratified by 128 countries, where decisions are made by consensus. That means any single country can thwart an agreement, and that any deal was likely to be based on a low common denominator.

GENEVA: Efforts to set firm rules on AI-powered killer robots and drones ran aground on Saturday (Nov 21) as UN-backed talks in Geneva produced a softened agreement to extend discussions for two more years.
Scores of countries ended the week-long UN conference on weapons by agreeing to “elaborate” a possible accord on such lethal autonomous weapons systems by 2028. But they did not commit to binding rules sought by UN Secretary-General António Guterres, many countries, and activists.
The outcome underscored the difficulty of achieving concrete results in diplomacy amid global conflicts and major military powers jockeying for dominance.
Izumi Nakamitsu, the UN high representative for disarmament affairs, hailed a “significant achievement” but acknowledged a “glass half full or half empty” scenario, citing Guterres’ hopes for a legally binding deal this year.

Activists accused military powers like Russia and the United States of blocking stronger language.

A mock "killer robot" is pictured as part of the Campaign to Stop "Killer Robots", which calls for the ban of lethal robot weapons that would be able to select and attack targets without any human intervention. (Photo: AFP/Carl Court)

Stop Killer Robots lamented a “watered-down mandate”, and Beatrice Fihn, founder of international law advocacy group Lex International, said the decision amounts to “pushing the can down the road for two more years".
They noted most countries supported work toward a new treaty, and Max Tegmark, a machine learning specialist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and founder of the Future of Life Institute, said: “States have agreed it is sufficient to just talk about the issue, for the 14th year, while these weapons enable atrocities.”
Before the meeting, seven countries proposed launching negotiations on a rulebook that could prevent or limit the ability of machines to kill without human control or accountability. That effort fell short.
“Technology is moving faster than diplomacy,” said Ambassador Frederico Meyer of Brazil, which joined Austria, Belgium, Ireland, Mexico, New Zealand and Panama in proposing such negotiations. “Diplomats are very slow.”
After years of talks on the issue, advocacy groups bemoaned obstructionism largely by Russia, which, like other top AI weapons-developing countries such as the United States, wants a freer hand to develop such high-tech weapons.
Guterres, who leaves office at the end of the year, set a 2026 deadline for launching negotiations toward an agreement on autonomous weapons systems.
Pope Leo XIV and many advocacy and humanitarian groups have framed the issue as an existential debate, urging quick action to rein in AI weapons before they become too commonplace to regulate easily.
Activists say armed drones that can independently strike targets have already been deployed in some select instances in conflict zones, but widespread rollout hasn’t happened.
Talks this week centred on the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons, ratified by 128 countries, where decisions are made by consensus. That means any single country can thwart an agreement, and that any deal was likely to be based on a low common denominator.

IOTX Info
IoTeX (IOTX) is an open-source blockchain platform specifically designed for the Internet of Things (IoT) with a strong emphasis on scalability, privacy, isolation, and the ability to develop decentralized applications and IoT ecosystems.
IoTeX was created to address the technical challenges faced by existing IoT ecosystems, such as security issues, high maintenance costs, and scalability limitations. The project is developing a new blockchain architecture to support a large number of IoT devices.
At the core of IoTeX is the concept of "blockchain within a blockchain." The main network, or "root blockchain," is responsible for network management and security, while internal blockchains, or "sub-blockchains," are used to manage various IoT devices and process transactions.
The IoTeX network utilizes its native token, IOTX, for operations such as transaction fee payments and participation in network governance.

items.title: サッカー＝バロンドールのケーン、左足首の靱帯断裂で数カ月離脱へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガで首位に立つバイエルン・ミュンヘンは２０日、イングランド代表ＦＷハリー・ケーン（３３）が左足首の靱帯を断裂し、数カ月間離脱すると発表した。

ケーンは同日のケルンとのホーム戦で負傷し、開始２０分で交代。試合は１─１の引き分けに終わった。

バイエルンは声明で、クラブの医療チームによる検査で靱帯断裂が確認されたと説明。具体的な離脱期間は明らかにしていないが、地元メディアは３カ月と報じている。

ケーンは先月、サッカー専門誌フランス・フットボールなどが選定する権威ある最優秀選手「バロンドール」を初受賞した。昨季は公式戦５１試合に出場し、自己最多の６１得点を記録。チームを国内リーグとカップ戦の２冠に導いた。イングランド代表としても今夏のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）で６得点を挙げ、チームの４強入りに貢献。クラブと代表を合わせて７３得点をマークした。

また、同じ試合で途中交代したフランス代表ＦＷミカエル・オリーズは前足部の打撲と診断され、今後数日間にわたって治療を受けるという。

RIYADH: The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said on Saturday (Nov 21) that it had intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired towards Riyadh, marking the second Houthi attack on the Saudi capital in a few days, after its tallest skyscraper was struck on Thursday.
A Reuters witness saw a projectile streak across the sky in Riyadh shortly before hearing a loud bang. The projectile left a trail of smoke in the sky.
The latest attack followed an escalation in cross-border strikes on Friday, when the Saudi-led coalition said it had struck the Red Sea port of Hodeidah and carried out operations targeting Houthi missile and drone capabilities in the capital Sanaa.
The Houthis threatened to target Saudi Red Sea ports, warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, and claimed attacks on a power station and port in southern Saudi Arabia.

The developments signalled a worsening of a conflict that has brought a humanitarian crisis to Yemen and severe disruption to Saudi Arabia, in parallel with the US-led war against Iran.
On Thursday, a Houthi attack damaged the Public Investment Fund tower , the headquarters of Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund and the tallest skyscraper in Riyadh.
Saudi Arabia, a close ally of the United States, has been backing Yemen's internationally recognised government for more than a decade in a war that was fought to a stalemate in 2022 but reignited in July.
The Houthis have seized Yemen's Red Sea coast and forced the Saudi-backed forces aligned with the government to retreat to defend their temporary capital in the southern port of Aden.

items.title: 5.7-magnitude earthquake strikes China
items.summary: An earthquake of magnitude 5.7 struck China at a depth of 80 kilometres on Saturday, the National Center for Seismology (NCS) said, reporting another seismic event in the country earlier this month.
items.body:
5.7-magnitude earthquake strikes China An earthquake of magnitude 5.7 struck China at a depth of 80 kilometres on Saturday, the National Center for Seismology (NCS) said, reporting another seismic event in the country earlier this month.
ANI | Updated: 21-11-2026 17:18 IST | Created: 21-11-2026 17:18 IST

Representational Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

An earthquake of magnitude 5.7 struck China at a depth of 80 kilometres on Saturday, the National Center for Seismology (NCS) said, reporting another seismic event in the country earlier this month. According to the NCS, the earthquake occurred at 4:15:37 pm IST on November 21, at latitude 37.099° North and longitude 96.482° East, with its location reported in China.
In a post on X, the National Center for Seismology stated, "EQ of M: 5.7, On: 21/11/2026 16:15:37 IST, Lat: 37.099 N, Long: 96.482 E, Depth: 80 Km, Location: China." The latest earthquake comes after a 4.4-magnitude tremor was recorded in China on November 5. The earlier earthquake occurred at 6:19:17 am IST at a shallow depth of 10 kilometres, with its epicentre at latitude 32.592° North and longitude 94.291° East, according to the NCS.
In its post on X, the NCS reported, "EQ of M: 4.4, On: 05/11/2026 06:19:17 IST, Lat: 32.592 N, Long: 94.291 E, Depth: 10 Km, Location: China." The two earthquakes fall into different depth categories under the classification outlined by the United States Geological Survey (USGS).
While the November 5 earthquake, at a depth of 10 kilometres, falls in the shallow category, the latest tremor, recorded at 80 kilometres, is classified as an intermediate-depth earthquake. According to the USGS, earthquakes occurring between 0 and 70 kilometres are classified as shallow, those between 70 and 300 kilometres as intermediate, and those between 300 and 700 kilometres as deep earthquakes.
The USGS further explains that the term "deep-focus earthquakes" is generally applied to earthquakes occurring at depths greater than 70 kilometres. It also notes that all earthquakes deeper than 70 kilometres are localised within great slabs of lithosphere that are sinking into the Earth's mantle. Explaining the relationship between earthquake depth and surface shaking, the USGS states that "the strength of shaking from an earthquake diminishes with increasing distance from the earthquake's source". It further observes that shaking at the surface from an earthquake occurring at 500 kilometres deep is considerably less than that from an earthquake of the same magnitude occurring at 20 kilometres depth.
The USGS also states that earthquakes occur in the crust or upper mantle, which extends from the Earth's surface to about 800 kilometres. (ANI)

Explaining earthquake depths, the USGS classifies earthquakes occurring between 0 and 70 kilometres as shallow, those between 70 and 300 kilometres as intermediate, and those between 300 and 700 kilometres as deep earthquakes.
The USGS further explains that the term "deep-focus earthquakes" is generally applied to earthquakes occurring at depths greater than 70 kilometres. It also notes that all earthquakes deeper than 70 kilometres are localised within great slabs of lithosphere that are sinking into the Earth's mantle. On the impact of earthquake depth on surface shaking, the USGS states that "the strength of shaking from an earthquake diminishes with increasing distance from the earthquake's source".
It adds that shaking at the surface from an earthquake occurring at 500 kilometres deep is considerably less than that from an earthquake of the same magnitude occurring at 20 kilometres depth. According to the USGS, earthquakes occur in the crust or upper mantle, extending from the Earth's surface to depths of about 800 kilometres. (ANI)

items.title: サッカー＝ＦＩＦＡ会長、アジア歴訪で支持固め　田嶋氏ら対立候補に高い壁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２０日　ロイター］ - 国際サッカー連盟（ＦＩＦＡ）のジャンニ・インファンティノ会長が、来年３月の会長選に向けてアジア各地を精力的に飛び回り、支持固めを進めている。１０月には一時対立したアジア・サッカー連盟（ＡＦＣ）が再選支持に転換。対立候補にとって現職の牙城を崩す難しさが浮き彫りとなっている。

ＦＩＦＡは１９日、会長選の候補者３人を発表。再選を目指すインファンティノ氏のほか、日本サッカー協会（ＪＦＡ）の田嶋幸三名誉会長、フランス・サッカー連盟（ＦＦＦ）のフィリップ・ディアロ会長の出馬が公表された。

その数時間後、タイで開かれたＡＦＣの年間表彰式に姿を現したインファンティノ氏は、年間最優秀選手に選出されたイラン代表ＧＫアリレザ・ベイランバンドに金色に輝くトロフィーを手渡し、自身の存在感を示した。田嶋氏は会場を訪れたが、ディアロ会長は出席しなかった。

インファンティノ氏は今夏、新会社「ＦＩＦＡフォワード・エンタープライズ（ＦＦＥ）」を設立してＷ杯などの商業権益を移管する計画を公表するも、広範な反発を受けて撤回。ＡＦＣは、欧州サッカー連盟（ＵＥＦＡ）や北中米カリブ海サッカー連盟（ＣＯＮＣＡＣＡＦ）と共にインファンティノ氏を批判する公開書簡を発表した。しかし、同氏による支持回復への働きかけを経て、先月下旬には再び同氏を支持する方針に転換した。

インファンティノ氏は、カタール航空から提供されたプライベートジェットで３カ月以上にわたってベトナムや香港、インドネシア、ブータン、サウジアラビアなどアジア各地を飛び回り、精力的な動きで支持固めを進めている。

それに対し、田嶋氏は２０日の会見で選挙活動の資金について、「日本サッカー協会からのサポートもいただきたいが、日本協会の今年の予算はすでに決まっている。プライベートジェットに乗って移動するつもりはない。あるものでしっかりとやっていくつもり」と言及。主に自己資金で活動する自身にはインファンティノ氏と同じような活動は難しいと認め、「目立つべきなのは会長ではなくて選手」とも述べた。

items.title: サッカー＝ブレイディ氏、チェルシーの株式取得と報道　ＮＦＬのレジェンド
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２０日　ロイター］ - 米プロフットボールリーグ（ＮＦＬ）のレジェンド、トム・ブレイディ氏（４９）がパートナーらと共にイングランド・プレミアリーグのチェルシーの株式を取得し、同クラブの少数株主になったと、米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮが２０日に報じた。取引の詳細は明らかにされていない。

ＥＳＰＮによれば、ブレイディ氏は弁護士のアレックス・スピロ氏を含むグループの一員として参加。スピロ氏が買収交渉を支援したという。クラブにおける議決権は持たないと伝えられている。

英紙ガーディアンによると、ブレイディ氏はクリアレイク・キャピタルの共同創業者であるベフダド・エグバリ氏と良好な関係にある。クリアレイク・キャピタルは９月に米実業家トッド・ボーリー氏とマーク・ウォルター氏から株式を取得。現在、チェルシーの株式８６．５％を保有している。

ブレイディ氏はイングランド・チャンピオンシップ（２部相当）に所属するバーミンガムの共同オーナー兼諮問委員長を務めていたが、今月初めに同クラブの保有株式を売却。ＥＳＰＮによれば、同氏はバーミンガムの株式３．３％を保有していた。ほかにも、ＮＦＬのレイダーズの株式５％を保有している。

チェルシーは今季のプレミアリーグで１０試合を終えて５勝１分け４敗。勝ち点１６で５位につけている。

items.summary: Visibility at Birsa Munda Airport remained around 1,000 metres until 1 pm, below the 1,200-1,500 metres required for safe take-offs and landings, an airport official said ...
items.body:
Home / India News / Cyclone Akvan disrupts air traffic, 20 flights cancelled in Ranchi

Cyclone Akvan disrupts air traffic, 20 flights cancelled in Ranchi Visibility at Birsa Munda Airport remained around 1,000 metres until 1 pm, below the 1,200-1,500 metres required for safe take-offs and landings, an airport official said

Children walk along the shore ahead of the expected landfall of Cyclone Akvan in Aryapalli, Odisha, India, November 20 | REUTERS

Press Trust of India Ranchi 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 21 2026 | 4:25 PM IST

Listen to This Article

As many as 20 flights were cancelled at the Birsa Munda Airport here on Saturday due to inclement weather triggered by cyclone 'Akvan', an official said.
Jharkhand has been experiencing cloudy weather coupled with light rain since Friday under the influence of the cyclone.
For safe landing or take-off, a visibility between 1,200 and 1,500 metres is required.
"The visibility at Ranchi airport was around 1,000 metres until 1pm," Airport Director Vinod Kumar told PTI.
In all, 20 scheduled flights were cancelled due to bad weather, including six Air India Express flights, an airport official said.

In addition, four flights were diverted due to inclement weather.
 

The state's weather is likely to improve from Sunday with clearing of clouds, an IMD official said.
"We are expecting the weather to improve from Sunday with dense fog in the morning hours. A clear sunshine is likely from November 23," Baburaj PP, director at Ranchi Meteorological Centre, told PTI.
Chaibasa Sadar in West Singbhum district recorded highest rainfall at 34.4 mm during the past 24 hours till 8.30am on Saturday.
Ghatsila in East Singhbhum district registered 32.6 mm rainfall, Simega 28.2mm, Jamshedpur 22.2 mm and Ranchi recorded 12.4 mm rainfall.
The maximum temperature is likely to remain unchanged for the next 24 hours in the state and thereafter it will start rising by 6 degree Celsius during the next three days, according to the weather bulletin.

Similarly, the minimum temperature is likely to drop by 5 degree Celsius over the next two days, it stated.
Ranchi registered a minimum temperature at 17.5 degree Celsius, 4.4 notches above the normal, while Jamshedpur recorded minimum at 19.6 degree Celsius and Daltonganj at 19.8 degree Celsius on Saturday.

items.title: ホンダとトヨタ、計160万台リコール　タカタ製エアバッグに破裂リスク
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - ホンダとトヨタ自動車は２０日、タカタ製エアバッグインフレーターに破裂リスクがあるとして、乗用車、トラック、ＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）計約１６０万台をリコールすると発表した。

両社はともに、リコール対象車両に関連した負傷者や事故は発生しておらず、エアバッグインフレーターの破裂事例も報告されていないと述べた。

しかし、２００９年以降、欠陥のあるタカタ製エアバッグインフレーターに起因して、米国では少なくとも２８人が死亡し、４００人以上が負傷。この問題は米国史上最大規模の自動車リコールを引き起こした。これらの死亡事例は全て、乾燥剤を含まないエアバッグインフレーターが関与していた。そのうち少なくとも２０件はホンダ車での事例だった。

今回リコール対象となっている車両のエアバッグインフレーターには、吸湿材が含まれている。以前にリコールされた数百万台の車両とは異なる点だ。

米道路交通安全局（ＮＨＴＳＡ）は、独立した試験機関による分析およびインフレーターの劣化シミュレーションモデルにより、自動車メーカーが潜在的なリスクに先んじて対応できたと指摘。「ホンダとトヨタは、一部の車両において劣化リスクの初期兆候を把握しており、現在、先手を打った形でリコールを実施している」と述べ、他の自動車メーカーも引き続きインフレーターの分析と試験を行っていると付け加えた。

今回のリコール対象の内訳は、米国内の古いモデルのホンダ車が８１万０５９２台、世界中のトヨタ車が７９万台（うち米国で３１万４０００台）となっている。
